exposure: Amniotic sheet with a hammock-like placenta
outcome: Placental injury secondary to premature rupture of membranes (risk)
cohort: A 25-year-old woman with a history of two dilation and curettage procedures, found to have an amniotic cavity separated by a septum containing part of the placenta.
finding: Aggressive and careful perinatal management, including continuous intravenous ritodrine hydrochloride and magnesium sulfate, and elective cesarean section, is required in cases of an amniotic sheet with a hammock-like placenta to mitigate the risk of umbilical cord complications and placental injury.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was performed for delivery.
